name: Unidad Reajustable
note: The value in pesos of Uruguay's Unidad Reajustable for each month from January 2024 to September 2026, the latest month in the Instituto Nacional de Estadística's series (spreadsheet UR.xls, linked from INE's page 'Series históricas de Unidad Reajustable (UR)', last saved 14 September 2026, downloaded and read 2026-10-30, converted to text by w13/U13_1.py). INE says the UR is a unit of measure whose value is adjusted periodically by the Índice Medio de Salarios over the previous twelve months; the spreadsheet's own footnote names the Banco Hipotecario del Uruguay (BHU) as its source, so INE publishes a value the BHU sets. Reading: INE's spreadsheet dates each value by the month it is in force, its 'Mes y año' column holding the first of that month. INE states no more than 'Mes y año' about it, so the reading rests on the Executive's decrees and the DGI: Decreto 38/025 fixes the UR 'correspondiente al mes de enero de 2025, vigente desde el 1° de febrero de 2025' at $ 1.747,25, which INE lists under 2025-02-01; Decreto 268/025 fixes the UR of October 2025, in force from 1 November 2025, at $ 1.839,08, which INE lists under 2025-11-01; and the DGI's table, which labels each value by the month it was set for and says it applies during the following month, gives January 2026 as 1.851,83 and February 2026 as 1.911,53, which INE lists under 2026-02-01 and 2026-03-01. So 'from' here is the first day of the month each value applies to, and it holds to the end of that month. INE's row for July 2025 is a text cell written '1.829,06' (Uruguayan decimal comma); it is read as 1829.06. The DGI page (dated 4 September 2026, read 2026-10-30) already shows the September 2026 value, 1.946,95, which applies during October 2026; INE's spreadsheet doesn't have it yet, so it isn't written here. The form doesn't hold the Unidad Reajustable de Alquileres (URA) or the rent adjustment coefficient, which INE publishes beside the UR.

sources.title: INE (Uruguay), Series históricas de Unidad Reajustable (UR)
sources.said: Series históricas de Unidad Reajustable (UR) ... Es una unidad de medida, su valor es ajustado periódicamente en función del Índice Medio de Salarios cuantificándose las variaciones en los doce meses anteriores. ... Unidad Reajustable. Valor en pesos uruguayos (09/1968-)
